source: W20 core, Pack Totems, pp. 371-377 (pdf 373-379). Rules in our own words with page refs. A totem's Individual Traits hold for every packmate while the totem favors the pack; each Pack Trait is held by one packmate at a time for the scene; a pool of Willpower is shared and comes back each story; a broken Ban turns every benefit off until a Rite of Contrition (p. 372).

rows.name: Falcon
rows.ban: The pack may never lose permanent Honor; one who does must set it right at once, or perform a Rite of Contrition and then hurl themself at a mighty servant of the Wyrm.

rows.name: Grandfather Thunder

effects.note: +2 dice to Intimidation when the name is invoked

rows.ban: Never show peers or rivals more respect than their deeds have earned; flattery offends Thunder.

rows.name: Pegasus
rows.refuses: a pack with a Get of Fenris in it
rows.ban: Never turn away a female of any species who needs help, the young above all.

rows.name: Stag
rows.friends: Fianna (and often fae, spirits and changelings)
rows.ban: Help any fae or spirit that asks, and honor the prey: a Prayer for the Prey after every kill on the hunt.

rows.name: Bear

notes: Mother's Touch once a day without knowing the Gift
May sleep up to three months with no food or water

rows.ban: None: seeking Bear has already cost the pack its standing among the Garou.

rows.name: Boar
rows.ban: Never hunt or eat a wild boar.

rows.name: Fenris
rows.friends: Get of Fenris (who test the pack with Wild Hunts and hard fights)
rows.ban: Never let a worthy fight go by.

rows.name: Griffin

notes: Speaks with birds of prey without a Gift

rows.refuses: a pack with a homid in it
rows.ban: Keep no company with humans.

rows.name: Rat
rows.friends: Bone Gnawers (and Ratkin put up with the pack)
rows.ban: Never kill vermin of any kind.

rows.name: Wendigo
rows.ban: Help animist peoples in need.

rows.name: Chimera

effects.note: -2 difficulty to riddles, dreams and enigmas

notes: In the Umbra, a Gnosis roll (difficulty 7) disguises the Garou as something else

rows.ban: None set: the pack must seek enlightenment, by any road it likes.

rows.name: Cockroach

effects.note: -2 difficulty with computers, electricity and applied science

notes: In the Umbra, a Gnosis roll (difficulty 6) reads a data stream: a call, a broadcast, a message

rows.ban: Never kill a cockroach.

rows.name: Owl

notes: Grows wings in the Umbra and flies

rows.friends: Silent Striders (Rat's packs and the Ratkin are cool toward them)
rows.ban: Leave small rodents bound and helpless in the woods for Owl and his kind.

rows.name: Raven
rows.ban: Carry no wealth: Raven provides.

rows.name: Uktena

effects.tick: Dealing with Garou of a tribe other than Uktena or Wendigo
effects.note: +1 difficulty to Social rolls with other tribes

notes: 2 extra experience each story for Enigmas, Occult, Rituals, Gifts or other mystic lore

rows.friends: Uktena (who treat the pack as kin)
rows.ban: Win back mystic lore, objects, places and creatures from the Wyrm's servants.

rows.name: Unicorn

effects.tick: Hurting a Garou who is not of the Wyrm

notes: Moves at twice the usual speed in the Umbra

rows.friends: Children of Gaia (who back the pack in disputes)
rows.ban: Protect and help the weak and the exploited, so long as that does not serve the Wyrm.

rows.name: Coyote

notes: Coyote's avatars always find the pack: no Totem points needed for it

rows.ban: None: Coyote would never bind his packs.

rows.name: Cuckoo

notes: One packmate at a time can pass unremarked: Manipulation + Subterfuge (difficulty 6, more where they look out of place); a watcher needs more successes on Perception + Alertness, and drawing attention means a new roll at +2 (p. 377)

rows.ban: Never pass up a chance to better the pack's lot at others' cost.

rows.name: Fox
rows.ban: Never ride in a fox hunt, and spoil any fox hunt met.

rows.name: Sable

notes: Call the Breeze once a day without knowing the Gift
Extreme cold does no lethal harm
Wind spirits are allies and speak freely without Spirit Speech

rows.ban: The pack may never cross the borders of Siberia, for any reason.

rows.name: Minotaur

notes: Spirits will teach packmates most Gifts up to Rank Three, paid for as Gifts of another tribe

rows.ban: Hurt and kill every follower of Pegasus met; no Black Fury may live in peace.
